record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.tooling: WHMCS cart at lowhosting.org/clientarea while the marketing site is lowhosting.com, so the order domain differs from the site domain; three product families chosen before the plan table; anti-DDoS included on every plan
record.chaining: EUR 3 for 1 GB and 20 GB NVMe is the lowest euro price among evaluated providers, and the 200 Mbps port plus a 20 GB disk make it a control node or a proxy exit rather than a store; the same table's 12 GB plan at EUR 16 carries a lower price per GB of RAM than the entry plan, so the entry plan is not where the value is if the workload is memory-bound.

limits.value: the vendor table says 'Unlimited*2' and the footnote text did not render, while the tracker states 51,200 GB a month; take 51.2 TB as the allowance until the footnote is read. The 200 Mbps port is the tighter limit for bulk transfer, and the 20 GB NVMe caps local caching
